{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk chiffon blouse in deep emerald green (#046A38), loose draped cut with a relaxed V-neckline, falling to the hip, lightweight and fluid fabric.
Wool-cashmeré blend trousers in charcoal slate (#3F4546), tailored wide-leg silhouette that gently flares from the knee, mid-weight drape for autumnal comfort.
Structured blazer in matte black (#000000), single-breasted cut with padded shoulders and notched lapels, elbow-length length to balance the fluidity of the trousers.
Leather ankle boots in polished burgundy (#800020), pointed toe with a 7-centimeter stiletto heel, sleek silhouette that elongates the leg while providing secure footing for an evening outing.

This outfit works perfectly for an autumn evening at the theatre by adhering to the requested "smart" dress code while respecting the seasonal weather; the structured blazer provides necessary warmth without overwhelming the silhouette, allowing the soft silk blouse to maintain an elegant, refined look suitable for a performance. The choice of dark, rich tones like emerald green and burgundy against charcoal and black creates a sophisticated palette that glows under stage lighting, ensuring she stands out respectfully among the audience. Finally, the wide-leg trousers paired with pointed-toe heels offer a harmonious blend of traditional formality and modern comfort, enabling her to move gracefully through the lobby and aisles while feeling poised for the show."}
